stem: PPFD mapping is uniform at the top of the canopy, but interior measurements vary widely. What does this imply?
choices: Top-plane uniformity can coexist with poor internal light distribution, so canopy depth should be evaluated separately
The light map proves every leaf receives equal light
The room must have a nutrient imbalance
rationale: Uniformity at one measurement plane does not guarantee uniform light penetration through canopy depth.
